About PDF Form Filler

Fill in a fillable PDF form — text fields, tick boxes, drop-downs — and save it, either still editable or flattened so the answers can't be changed.

How it works

  1. 1Drop in the form; its fields appear below.
  2. 2Fill them in.
  3. 3Choose Keep editable or Flatten, then save.

Common questions

My PDF shows no fields.

It isn't a fillable form — probably a scan or a plain document. Use Edit PDF to type over it instead.

What does Flatten do?

It turns your answers into fixed page content so they display the same everywhere and can't be edited.

Can I sign the form here too?

Fill and save it, then use Sign PDF on the result.

Often used next
